name: BetterMediaInfo [anylinux]
description:
BetterMediaInfo is a modern, cross-platform graphical frontend for MediaInfo. It displays comprehensive technical and tag data about video, audio, and container files in an organized, searchable desktop interface.

Features:
- Detailed inspection of container formats, video codecs, audio tracks, and subtitles
- Clean multi-tabbed interface with tree, text, and sheet viewing modes
- Batch processing and side-by-side comparison of multiple media files
- Exporting technical reports to JSON, XML, CSV, and plain text formats
- Fast analysis powered by the latest underlying MediaInfo library

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
